lines.en: Low growl as it moves
Wings flap lightly
Low growl as it chases
Dive to catch prey
Pass by your ear
Beak pecks at the ground
Calls for food
Swiftly flies by

lines.zh: 我扑棱两下，掠过矮蕨的尖。
lines.en: Two flaps carry me over the low fern tips.
Low growl while flying
It trots past the ferns.
A flick of its tail turns it behind the bush.

lines.zh: 三趾的脚印踩在湿泥上
lines.en: Three-toed prints press into the wet mud.

lines.zh: 它屈腿蓄力，一跃而过石堆
lines.en: It crouches and leaps over the pile of stones.
Stands still, staring

lines.zh: 草叶一动，我就把脑袋转过去。
lines.en: At the least stir of grass, I turn my head.
Stretches its wings

lines.zh: 我在数沙地上几只小蜥蜴。
lines.en: I am counting the little lizards on the sand.
I only go after the smallest prey.
Walks around, observing
Pecks at the ground
Mumbles to itself
Opens its mouth wide
Lowers its head in thought
It tilts its head, listening to something far off.
It tucks its foreclaws to its chest to rest.
Mouth half open, it cools down and stays alert.

lines.zh: 尾巴轻轻扫地，扫开落叶
lines.en: Its tail brushes the fallen leaves aside.
Eyes on you
Looks down at you
Approaches to examine

lines.zh: 我盯住你的脚踝，琢磨咬不咬。
lines.en: I fix on your ankle, weighing whether to bite.
On tiptoe I barely reach your waist.
Low growl of warning
Opens mouth in warning

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸长，装成更大的龙。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to pose as a bigger beast.
Low growl as warning
Hisses as warning

lines.zh: 它仰头看你，脖子一伸一缩
lines.en: It looks up at you, neck bobbing.

lines.zh: 绕着你走，判断你有多大
lines.en: It circles you, sizing you up.

lines.zh: 我想叫，只挤出一点气声。
lines.en: I try to call and only squeeze out a breath.

lines.zh: 我缩在蕨叶下，抖得停不下来。
lines.en: I huddle under a fern, shaking without end.
Wounded badly
Staggering walk
Hissing sound
A hit to the bone pulls out a cry.

lines.zh: 我趴着喘，喉咙里全是血味。
lines.en: I lie panting, blood in my throat.
Slow movements
Depressed posture
Scraped body
Smell the meat, can’t resist.

lines.zh: 附近有吃的，别想打我主意。
lines.en: Food nearby, no tricks.
Small prey, good meat.
Close enough to feel me.
Claws, for raw meat.
Eat, your reward.
I only go for things smaller than me.
Don’t steal my food.

lines.zh: 我的头骨，很有纪念价值。
lines.en: My skull, valuable.

lines.zh: 享受这一刻，你会成为我的。
lines.en: Enjoy now, yours.
Watch out, collision.
Collision, who wins?
Say it with body, come on.

lines.zh: 我只追最小的猎物，你别挡。
lines.en: I only chase the smallest prey; do not block me.
My strength, shakes you.
Force test, who backs.
Test your hardness.

lines.zh: 身体接触，看谁更胜一筹。
lines.en: Body test, who wins.
Find advantage, collide.
Test bodies, here I am.

lines.zh: 六天就长到一格高，该找伴了。
lines.en: Six days and I am a block tall; time to find a mate.
First let me see if you are small enough.
Mate, for the race.
Find the moment.
Mate, race’s survival.
Careful, mating.
Mate, life’s legacy.
Find a partner.
Mate, life cycle.
Find the right time.

lines.zh: 低语声中带着轻微的嘶嘶声
lines.en: Whisper with a faint hiss
Nods at the fallen meat

lines.zh: 用爪子拨弄地面的骨头
lines.en: Taps the bones on the ground with its claw
Picks up a piece of raw meat from the ground

lines.zh: 闻了闻爪子上的血腥味
lines.en: Sniffs the blood on its claw
Mumbles contently

lines.zh: 用牙齿轻轻咬住一块肉
lines.en: Uses its teeth to grip a piece of meat
Stares at the dropped skull
Gently pecks at the dropped claw

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咕噜声，享受着战利品
lines.en: Rumbles contentedly with its loot
Glances at the nearby Stenonychosaurus

lines.zh: 我只对小个子有兴趣，你别动。
lines.en: I only care about small prey, so hold still.
Gleam in its eyes
Moves closer to Stenonychosaurus
Carefully observes the target
Moves in after confirming the target
Aim at the prey

lines.zh: 我盯上了那只更小的恐龙。
lines.en: I've set my eyes on that smaller dinosaur.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的嘶嘶声，锁定目标
lines.en: Whistles softly, locks onto the target
Focuses on the target, ready to pounce

lines.zh: 它盯上了一只更小的恐龙
lines.en: It fixes on a smaller dinosaur.
It lowers itself, head thrust forward.

lines.zh: 狭长的影子投在蕨丛上
lines.en: Its long shadow falls across the ferns.

lines.zh: 它把注意力从你身上挪开
lines.en: It moves its attention off you.

lines.zh: 张开血盆大口，准备吞噬
lines.en: Opens its wide mouth, ready to devour

lines.zh: 迅速扑向目标，利爪飞舞
lines.en: Pounces on the target, claws flying

lines.zh: 从空中俯冲而下，精准攻击
lines.en: Plummets from the sky, precise attack

lines.zh: 紧追不舍，不给目标喘息机会
lines.en: Pursues relentlessly, no breathing room

lines.zh: 迅猛撞击，试图将目标震昏
lines.en: Crashes into the target, trying to stun it
Claws tear through the target's skin

lines.zh: 用牙齿咬住猎物的脖子
lines.en: Bites the target's neck with its teeth

lines.zh: 猛烈摇晃，试图将目标摔死
lines.en: Shakes violently, trying to kill by smashing

lines.zh: 在目标倒下后，撕咬它的身体
lines.en: Tears at the target's body after it falls

lines.zh: 享用猎物，发出满足的叫声
lines.en: Feasts on the prey, making contented noises
Its hind legs coil, ready to bolt.
It flanks along the edge of the brush.
Its head dips and its teeth show.

lines.zh: 它踩着轻步，逼近那只小家伙
lines.en: It pads nearer to the little creature.

lines.zh: 呼吸急促，尾巴微微抬起
lines.en: Breathing fast, its tail lifts slightly.

lines.zh: 嘶鸣声中，它张开大嘴咬向目标！
lines.en: It lets out a snarl and bites at the target with its mouth open.

lines.zh: 爪子在地面上划过，发出咔嚓声！
lines.en: Its claws scrape against the ground, making a cracking sound.

lines.zh: 它的眼中闪着贪婪的光芒！
lines.en: Its eyes glow with a hungry light.

lines.zh: 一声低吼后，它扑向猎物！
lines.en: It lets out a low growl and charges at its prey.

lines.zh: 它的爪子深深嵌入地面！
lines.en: Its claws sink deep into the ground.
It approaches its prey with a hiss.

lines.zh: 它粗重的呼吸声回荡四周！
lines.en: Its heavy breathing echoes around.

lines.zh: 攻击前，它先低沉地咆哮！
lines.en: It rumbles lowly before attacking.

lines.zh: 它的利齿紧紧咬住猎物！
lines.en: Its sharp teeth clamp down on its prey.

lines.zh: 它发出一声威胁的嘶鸣！
lines.en: It lets out a warning hiss.
It bites down and shakes its head.
Foreclaws grip as its hind legs kick.

lines.zh: 它扑上去，撞翻了小猎物
lines.en: It pounces and bowls the small prey over.
Sharp teeth rake and leave a bloody line.

lines.zh: 在岩石缝隙中，它悄悄出现！
lines.en: It appears quietly in a crack in the rocks.

lines.zh: 它从洞穴深处缓缓走出！
lines.en: It emerges slowly from a deep cave.

lines.zh: 一群幼鸟飞过，它悄然现身！
lines.en: A flock of baby birds fly by, and it appears silently.

lines.zh: 它在低矮的灌木丛中现身！
lines.en: It appears in the low shrubs.

lines.zh: 它悄无声息地从草丛中跳出来！
lines.en: It jumps out silently from the grass.

lines.zh: 从远处的树林中，它慢慢现身！
lines.en: It slowly appears from the distant woods.

lines.zh: 它在黄昏时分现身于峡谷之中！
lines.en: It appears in the canyon at dusk.

lines.zh: 夜晚的树林里，它悄然出现！
lines.en: It appears silently in the forest at night.

lines.zh: 在废弃的矿井入口，它现身！
lines.en: It appears at the entrance of an abandoned mine.

lines.zh: 它在远处的山洞中现身！
lines.en: It appears in a distant cave.
It straightens up among the ferns.
Newly hatched, it shakes off the eggshell.

lines.zh: 泥地上留下新鲜的爪印
lines.en: Fresh claw marks appear in the mud.
It walks past the dig site.

lines.zh: 林间的落叶一动，它现身了
lines.en: The leaf litter stirs and there it is.
It stops to sun its back on a rock.

lines.zh: 远远传来一声尖细的鸣叫
lines.en: A thin call carries from far off.

lines.zh: 它从孵化场的围栏里跳出
lines.en: It hops out of the hatchery pen.
Burned skin

lines.zh: 落地时翅膀折了，我歪着走。
lines.en: My wing folded on landing, and I walk askew.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻孔，我扑腾着往下沉。
lines.en: Water fills my nostrils, and I flail downward.
Torn apart by explosion
An arrow went through my shoulder blade.
Burned by magic

lines.zh: 小蜥蜴都躲起来了，我腿发软。
lines.en: The little lizards hide, and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背脊上，羽毛焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my spine and singes my feathers.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我连叫都叫不出。
lines.en: The ground vanishes, and I can't even cry out.
